CommunityApplications.Profile: Net2Net maintains UniFi RADIUS Manager, a local network access appliance for Wi-Fi users, VLAN profiles, registered network devices, PEAP/MSCHAPv2 authentication and accounting. Source code, installation instructions and support are available at https://github.com/Net2NetMain/Net2NetUniFiRadius. Report issues at https://github.com/Net2NetMain/Net2NetUniFiRadius/issues.
